- Main Window Component (MainWindow.xaml)

- Property Grid Components
- System Colors Window
- Theme Management

b. Core Application Layer:
- RoboCopy Integration (ChoRoboCopyManager.cs)
- Task Queue Management (ChoTaskQManager.cs)
- Settings and Configuration
- Backup Management

c. Supporting Components:
- File System Integration
- Command Line Arguments Handler
- User Preferences Storage
- MRU (Most Recently Used) Management

Draw the diagram with these connections:
```
[User Interface Layer]
       ↕
[Core Application Layer]

[Windows RoboCopy Tool]

[File System]
```

  - Task Queue Manager
  - Backup Manager
  - Settings Manager

- Cylinders: Storage

  - MRU List
  - Saved Profiles

- Configuration data flow
- Task queue processing flow

5. Key Technical Elements to Highlight:

- WPF Framework usage (indicated by .xaml files)
- Custom Controls implementation
- Property Grid customization
- Theme management system
- Task queue architecture
- Profile management system

6. Integration Points:

Show clear connections for:
- Windows RoboCopy integration
- File system interaction
- Configuration storage
- Profile management

7. Architectural Patterns to Emphasize:

- MVVM Pattern (implicit in WPF structure)
- Observer Pattern (ChoObservableCollection)
- Command Pattern (for RoboCopy operations)
- Queue Pattern (task management)

Create the diagram using these guidelines:
1. Start with the UI layer at the top
2. Place core services in the middle
3. Show system integrations at the bottom
4. Use clear, consistent color coding
5. Include a legend
6. Add annotations for key features
